1 · Intro

When to use it.

In Oracle, a person has one person record, one or more work relationships with a legal employer, and one or more assignments inside each work relationship.

For student workers, the record the student already has tells you which action to use.

Use this whenYou are about to set up paid work for a student and need to pick Add Work Relationship or Add Assignment.

2 · Walk through

How to decide.

Check off each item as you read.

Pick the action
Student hasAction
Only an enrolled student (N) recordAdd the employment Work Relationship
An employee (E) assignmentAdd an assignment

Watch-outs

  • Adding a Work Relationship when an E assignment exists creates a duplicate employment relationship that is hard to unwind.
  • Open item: Confirm the exact Quick Action names Vanderbilt uses for these two actions in Our Workforce.

HCM Academy job aid · Students

Add a Work Relationship or add an Assignment?

Use when: You are about to set up paid work for a student and need to pick Add Work Relationship or Add Assignment. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Search the student in Our Workforce > Employment Info and look at the work relationships.
  2. Only an enrolled student (N) record: add the employment Work Relationship.
  3. Already has an employee (E) assignment: add an assignment.
    • End it later with End Assignment
  4. Never create a second person record.
Pick the action
